biological_reference.closest_mechanism: Ventral-stream manifold untangling (DiCarlo): a hierarchy whose functional role is to progressively flatten and separate behaviourally relevant variables so a simple downstream readout can use them. The biological existence proof is for the CLASS -- a trained sensory cascade that makes task-relevant structure MORE linearly accessible than its own input statistics would.
dependencies: a training signal that is coupled, however indirectly, to the behavioural variable the readout needs
sufficient representational width at the bottleneck (here: settled -- 32 dims demonstrably suffices, since a PCA-32 of the same input clears the bar)
biological_reference.divergence: LOAD-BEARING, and measured rather than asserted. In the reference, the cascade's training is what BUYS accessibility. Here, training buys nothing: the trained encoder's latent is at parity-or-below the SAME ARCHITECTURE at random initialisation (off_minus_untrained_best negative on 3/3 seeds: -0.0317 / -0.0049 / -0.0427), and it is the WORST of every 250->32 projection this lineage has measured. The divergence is not that REE's cascade untangles less well than a brain's; it is that REE's cascade does not untangle this variable AT ALL relative to its own random initialisation.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-1010 (2026-09-09, diagnostic PASS, claim-free) is the over-capacity decoder sweep commissioned by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1008_2026-09-08 section 8, and it CONFIRMS H-F-content-discarded-at-encode on the frozen-ledger question zworld_actor_adequacy_locus. Holding the representation, dataset, seeds, held-out split, standardiser and fit protocol fixed and varying ONLY the decoder's capacity across five rungs spanning ~77,000x in parameters (fitted linear -> 12.67M-parameter four-layer 2048-wide MLP), the frozen 978-OFF z_world latent reaches best-over-capacity held-out oracle-action agreement of 0.6839 / 0.6846 / 0.6656 (mean 0.6780), clearing the pre-registered 0.80 bar on 0 of 3 seeds and the 0.20 elevation floor on 0 of 3 (best elevations 0.1178 / 0.1043 / 0.0936 over per-seed prev-action trivial baselines of 0.5661 / 0.5803 / 0.5720). The null is not an under-powered reader: the SAME ladder on the SAME latent memorises the training split at 0.9996-0.9998 (Guard 2 floor 0.95). It is not an unsound protocol: the PCA-32 calibration anchor -- a task-agnostic linear compression of the encoder's OWN 250-dim input to the encoder's OWN 32-dim width, read by the same ladder -- reaches 0.8836 / 0.8729 / 0.8763 and clears BOTH thresholds on 3 of 3 seeds, with max-capacity-minus-consumer degradation of only -0.0196 (Guard 1 tolerance -0.10). It is not a blind instrument: the raw 25-dim resource field decodes the oracle at 0.9735-0.9832. It is not plausibly an under-sampled map: halving the training rows costs only 0.0136-0.0356 against a 0.122 mean gap to the bar. And a SECOND, reader-free witness -- the oracle's own argmax rule applied to a same-capacity nonlinear field decode, with no learned action head anywhere in the path -- independently tops out at 0.6546 / 0.6623 / 0.6478 per seed (maximum at mlp512 on all three) against those same trivial baselines, corroborating absence rather than reader failure. THE SHARPEST READING, and the one governance should bank, is the in-run negative control: the SAME ENCODER ARCHITECTURE AT RANDOM INITIALISATION reaches 0.7155 / 0.6895 / 0.7084, at or ABOVE the trained latent on 3 of 3 seeds (off_minus_untrained_best -0.0317 / -0.0049 / -0.0427). In THIS run both comparators beat the trained latent at EVERY rung on 3/3 seeds (PCA-32 best-over-capacity 0.8776; untrained 0.7045; trained 0.6780). V3-EXQ-1008 additionally places a random orthonormal 32-dim projection above the trained latent, at ONE reader capacity only (that run has no ladder), and within ITS OWN consumer-rung cells the 0.1998 PCA-to-trained gap decomposes as -0.0959 (what fitting a linear projection for variance preservation BUYS: 0.8684 -> 0.7725) / -0.0779 (what the encoder's nonlinear architecture costs at random init: 0.7725 -> 0.6946) / -0.0260 (what REE's objective costs on top: 0.6946 -> 0.6686) -- the single largest term being a preservation pressure neither the architecture nor the objective contains. Training contributes nothing positive at any capacity. Reading: the observation->z_world objective supplies no gradient toward decision-relevant content, so the latent never rises above what its random initialisation happens to preserve. Routed to /implement-substrate against SD-018 with a NEW shape and, for the first time in this lineage, a NUMERIC ACCEPTANCE TARGET set by an in-run control rather than by judgement: PCA-32 parity, >= 0.85 oracle-action agreement at the consumer rung. PROVENANCE CORRECTION, recorded because the driver asserts the opposite: this run executed on darwin-arm64-py3.13-torch2.12.0 (DLAPTOP), whereas V3-EXQ-1002 and V3-EXQ-1008 both executed on linux-x86_64-py3.10-torch2.12.0+cpu, so the driver docstring's claim that 'the OFF latent this run reads is the same object 1002 and 1008 read' is false -- the encoder-health fingerprints differ on 6 of 6 cells. The divergence is float-arithmetic scale (1e-7 to 3.7e-4 relative), NOT trajectory scale, so this is a near-replay with accumulated FP drift and NOT an independent warmup draw; H-D continues to rest on one run exactly as failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1008_2026-09-08 stated. What the machine-class change DOES buy is unplanned and worth banking: the OFF-latent shortfall reproduces to within 0.005 held-out agreement across a different OS, architecture, Python and torch build, so the finding is not a platform artifact.

read_across_not_adjudicated.detail: DRAFTED, TESTED, WITHDRAWN -- recorded rather than deleted. The draft of this artifact argued that because V3-EXQ-1010 ran on a DIFFERENT machine class from 1002/1008 (darwin-arm64-py3.13 vs linux-x86_64-py3.10) and the 978 warmup is re-run in-process through ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py -- which carries five live torch.multinomial call sites at the run's own substrate commit 63aa9f2, and multinomial is the one documented cross-machine-class divergent op -- the warmup must be an INDEPENDENT draw, thereby supplying the second instance that failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1008_2026-09-08 explicitly declined to claim. THE ARGUMENT WAS CHECKED BY MEASUREMENT AND DOES NOT HOLD. zworld_participation_ratio, 1008 vs 1010: OFF seeds 4.56505291002958 -> 4.565657594335131, 4.222778806991767 -> 4.222780095432731, 5.667190228544192 -> 5.665099767498349; UNTRAINED seeds 7.492851658629209 -> 7.492853548294216, 10.31264273380446 -> 10.312641567132374, 10.011804177727937 -> 10.011799420895613. All six differ, so bit-identity is genuinely broken -- but the UNTRAINED track, whose construction contains no sampling at all, differs by ~1e-7 relative, and the OFF track differs by at most 3.7e-4. A different multinomial category would have sent the trajectory somewhere O(1%) away, not 4 decimal places. The divergence is therefore accumulated floating-point reordering, not a re-draw. H-D's registry entry needs NO change: not a strengthening (there is still no independent instance), not a weakening (nothing contradicts it). Flagged so that a later session does not re-derive the tempting version of this argument and bank it.

targets.fanout_recommendation_note: CONSIDERED AND DELIBERATELY NOT EMITTED -- recorded because the draft of this artifact carried one. The draft proposed a two-leg GOV-FANOUT-1 portfolio discriminating 'the objective supplies no gradient' (axis learning-signal) from 'the architecture caps content at 32 dims' (axis intrinsic-architecture), on the ground that the two route to builds of very different cost. WITHDRAWN ON MEASUREMENT: the discrimination is already computable from banked data. V3-EXQ-1008 ran a FOUR-REPRESENTATION comparison at ONE reader capacity (adapter_trunk_hidden 128; that run has no capacity ladder at all), and within its OWN consumer-rung cells the 0.1998 PCA-to-trained gap decomposes as -0.0959 (what fitting a linear projection FOR VARIANCE PRESERVATION buys: PCA-32 0.8684 vs random orthonormal-32 0.7725) / -0.0779 (what the encoder's nonlinear architecture costs at random init: random orthonormal-32 0.7725 vs untrained encoder net 0.6946) / -0.0260 (what REE's objective costs on top: untrained 0.6946 vs trained 0.6686), total -0.1998. Both sub-hypotheses are true, the architecture term is ~3x the objective term, and the LARGEST term is a preservation pressure neither possesses. RED-TEAM CORRECTION APPLIED (defect 2): the draft computed this by mixing 1008's single-rung random-orthonormal value into 1010's best-over-capacity series, which is a category error -- 1008 has no ladder, so 0.7725 is a consumer-rung number. Recomputed consistently inside one run, the signs, the ordering and the conclusion are unchanged; only the warrant is repaired. Queueing a probe to split a decomposition already in hand would be `mystery (known data)` mis-routed as a spike, and is the letter-after-letter pattern the re-derive brake exists to stop. The frame changes instead: the build is not 'fix the objective OR fix the architecture', it is 'introduce a bottleneck preservation pressure at all'.
learning_extracted: AT THE ENCODER'S OWN WIDTH, ON THE ENCODER'S OWN INPUT, AND AT EVERY DECODER CAPACITY UP TO 12.67M PARAMETERS, REE'S TRAINED z_world IS THE WORST 250->32 PROJECTION THE LINEAGE HAS MEASURED. Verified rung-by-rung 3/3 in THIS run against the two comparators it carries: PCA-32 (best-over-capacity 0.8776) and its OWN ARCHITECTURE AT RANDOM INITIALISATION (0.7045) both beat the trained latent (0.6780) at every rung, and off_minus_untrained_best is negative on 3/3 seeds. V3-EXQ-1008 additionally places a RANDOM ORTHONORMAL 32-dim projection (0.7725) above the trained latent, but at ONE reader capacity only -- that run has no ladder, so the 'at every capacity' claim is NOT asserted for that comparator. Training the encoder does not merely fail to preserve decision-relevant content; it moves the representation nowhere positive on this axis at all.

THE GAP DECOMPOSES, AND THE DECOMPOSITION NAMES THE BUILD. Computed entirely INSIDE V3-EXQ-1008's own consumer-rung cells so that no single-rung value is mixed into a best-over-capacity series: of the 0.1998 PCA-to-trained gap, -0.0959 is what fitting a linear projection FOR VARIANCE PRESERVATION buys (0.8684 -> 0.7725), -0.0779 is what the encoder's nonlinear architecture costs at random init (0.7725 -> 0.6946), and -0.0260 is what REE's objective costs on top (0.6946 -> 0.6686). The single largest term is a pressure neither the architecture nor the objective contains. The repair is therefore not a better feature head; it is a bottleneck preservation pressure.

A CAPACITY SWEEP IS THE CHEAPEST WAY TO CONVERT 'THIS READER COULDN'T FIND IT' INTO 'IT ISN'T THERE', BUT ONLY WITH A MEMORISATION GUARD -- AND THE GUARD IS WEAKER THAN ITS FRAMING. Guard 2 (max over rungs of the OFF track's train-split agreement >= 0.95) is what licenses reading a flat held-out profile as a content statement, and without it the run is indistinguishable from an under-powered reader -- the ambiguity that kept this question open from V3-EXQ-978 through V3-EXQ-1008. But at 4.27M and 12.67M parameters against ~5,000 rows and 5 classes, memorisation is close to structurally assured, so the guard's live failure mode is really OPTIMISER DIVERGENCE (real, not hypothetical: the driver's own dry smoke hit CE 4.38 > ln(5)), not under-power. The PCA anchor and the saturation witness are doing more discriminating work than Guard 2 is.

A SAME-WIDTH, SAME-PROTOCOL, TASK-AGNOSTIC CONTROL IS WHAT MAKES A NULL FAIR. The objection 'a world-model objective owes nothing to a particular greedy rule' is fully answered by the PCA-32 anchor: the standard applied is parity with an UNSUPERVISED LINEAR COMPRESSION of the encoder's own input at the encoder's own width, fitted on the train split only and read by the same ladder. Nothing weaker could be asked, and the encoder does not meet it. Any future adequacy diagnostic on a learned representation should carry this control by default.

A DRIVER'S PROVENANCE PROSE CAN GO STALE BETWEEN AUTHORING AND EXECUTION, AND THE MANIFEST IS THE ONLY WITNESS. This driver asserts its machine class matches 1002/1008 -- while correcting 1008 for a machine-class error of the same family -- and it executed on darwin-arm64-py3.13 against their linux-x86_64-py3.10. The bit-identity claim it rests on is false on 6 of 6 encoder-health fingerprints.
